rid the world of poverty: Many charities are working together toward one big goal: to rid the world of poverty and hunger.
許多慈善團體正朝著一個遠大的目標共同努力：消除世界貧窮與飢餓。
get rid of: Before moving to the new apartment, we decided to get rid of old clothes and toys we no longer used.
搬進新公寓之前，我們決定擺脫那些不再使用的舊衣服和玩具。
rid oneself of bad habits: It took him months, but he finally managed to rid himself of bad habits like staying up late and skipping breakfast.
他花了好幾個月，終於成功戒除熬夜和不吃早餐等壞習慣。
be rid of: I'm so glad to be rid of that noisy old air conditioner, because the new one is very quiet.
我很高興終於擺脫了那台吵雜的舊冷氣，因為新的這台非常安靜。
ride a wave of popularity: After her song went viral online, the young singer was able to ride a wave of popularity across Asia.
她的歌在網路上爆紅後，這位年輕歌手得以乘著人氣浪潮紅遍亞洲。
ride out the storm: The small shop lost many customers during the pandemic, but the owner managed to ride out the storm by selling online.
這家小店在疫情期間流失許多顧客，但老闆靠著網路銷售成功度過風暴。
ride high: After winning three games in a row, the basketball team began to ride high and felt confident about the finals.
連贏三場比賽後，籃球隊開始春風得意，對決賽充滿信心。
let it ride: Your sister's comment was rude, but it was only a joke, so just let it ride and don't start a fight.
你姊姊的話雖然很無禮，但那只是個玩笑，所以就順其自然吧，別吵起來。
ride on: Our whole season will ride on this final game, so everyone must play their very best tonight.
我們整個球季的成敗將取決於這場最後的比賽，所以今晚每個人都必須全力以赴。
take someone for a ride: The salesman tried to take me for a ride by charging double the normal price for a used phone.
那個推銷員想欺騙我，一支二手手機竟然開出兩倍的正常價格。
ring a bell: Her name doesn't ring a bell at all; are you sure I met her at the party last year?
她的名字我聽起來一點也不耳熟；你確定我去年在派對上見過她嗎？
ring true: His excuse for being late didn't ring true, because the bus he mentioned had actually arrived on time.
他遲到的藉口聽來不真實，因為他說的那班公車其實準時到站了。
ring hollow: The politician's promises ring hollow to many voters, since he broke the same promises four years ago.
那位政治人物的承諾對許多選民來說聽來空洞，因為他四年前就違背過同樣的承諾。
ring in the new year: Thousands of people gathered near Taipei 101 to ring in the new year with fireworks and music.
數千人聚集在台北101附近，以煙火和音樂迎接新年。
ring the changes: To keep lessons interesting, our teacher likes to ring the changes by using games, videos, and group work.
為了讓課程保持有趣，我們老師喜歡做變化，輪流使用遊戲、影片和小組活動。
ring up sales: The new cashier was slow to ring up sales at the register, so a long line of customers quickly formed.
新來的收銀員在收銀機前結帳很慢，所以很快就排起了長長的人龍。
riot in the streets: When the unfair election results were announced, angry crowds began to riot in the streets, breaking windows and burning cars.
不公平的選舉結果公布後，憤怒的群眾開始在街頭暴動，砸破窗戶、焚燒汽車。
a riot of color: In spring, the garden becomes a riot of color, with red, yellow, and purple flowers everywhere.
春天時，花園變得五彩繽紛，到處都是紅色、黃色和紫色的花。
run riot: If parents let their kids run riot in the restaurant, other customers cannot enjoy their meals in peace.
如果家長讓孩子在餐廳裡失控亂跑，其他客人就無法安心享用餐點。
read the riot act: Mom will read the riot act to my brother if he comes home after midnight again tonight.
如果我哥今晚又過了半夜才回家，媽媽一定會嚴厲警告他。
rip someone off: That taxi driver tried to rip us off by taking a much longer route to the airport.
那個計程車司機想敲我們竹槓，故意繞了一條遠得多的路去機場。
rip up the contract: The angry singer threatened to rip up the contract after the company refused to pay him fairly.
公司拒絕公平支付酬勞後，憤怒的歌手揚言要撕毀合約。
rip apart an argument: The clever lawyer was able to rip apart an argument that the other side had spent weeks preparing.
那位聰明的律師徹底駁倒了對方花了好幾週準備的論點。
rip through the town: The powerful typhoon began to rip through the town at midnight, tearing roofs off many houses.
強烈颱風在半夜開始席捲小鎮，掀掉了許多房子的屋頂。
let rip: At the karaoke party, everyone finally let rip and sang their favorite songs as loudly as possible.
在KTV派對上，大家終於盡情發洩，用最大的音量唱著自己最愛的歌。
rise to the challenge: Although the exam was very hard, most students managed to rise to the challenge and passed with good grades.
雖然考試非常難，大多數學生仍成功迎接挑戰，並以好成績通過。
rise to fame: The young actor began to rise to fame after his role in a popular TV drama last year.
這位年輕演員在去年演出一部熱門電視劇之後開始成名。
rise to the occasion: Nobody expected the shy girl to win, but she managed to rise to the occasion and gave an amazing speech.
沒有人預料到那個害羞的女孩會贏，但她臨場發揮，發表了一場精彩的演講。
rise above: Good leaders try to rise above personal feelings and make decisions that are fair to everyone.
好的領導者會努力超越個人情緒，做出對每個人都公平的決定。
prices rise: When prices rise quickly, many families have to spend less money on eating out and travel.
當物價快速上漲時，許多家庭不得不減少外食和旅遊的花費。
rise against: Tired of unfair taxes, the farmers decided to rise against the cruel king and his army.
受夠了不公平的稅賦，農民決定起義反抗殘暴的國王和他的軍隊。
rise through the ranks: She started as a waitress, but she managed to rise through the ranks and became the restaurant's manager.
她從服務生做起，但一路逐步晉升，最後成為餐廳經理。
give rise to: Using phones late at night can give rise to sleep problems and poor performance at school.
深夜使用手機可能引起睡眠問題和在校表現不佳。
